name: Shanghai Hailiang Agriculture Group Co., Ltd. (上海海粮农业集团有限公司)
note: Grain group (growing, storage, processing, transport, sale); its own site says Shanghai Hailiang Agriculture Group was founded in February 2023 with RMB 2 billion registered capital. Registry aggregator Qichamao's entry (behind a login wall: its page returns the same login screen for any address, so neither CI nor reviewers can confirm it) reportedly names Lu Yiming (卢一铭) as legal representative (Qingpu, Shanghai, 2023-02-15) and lists two natural-person shareholders, Lu Yiming and Wang Abing (王阿兵) — unverified by this review. Liaoning Hailiang Agriculture Group Co., Ltd., which signed the Liaoning Tieren partnership, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Hailiang group per the group's own site.
